overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Feb. 6, 2025 budget notice was sufficiently specific, and a vote to close Ashby Elementary was reasonably foreseeable from the budget discussion.

allegations.summary: Four complaints allege the Feb. 6, 2025 notice was insufficient because it did not say the Committee would vote to close Ashby Elementary School.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notice was not insufficiently specific as to the vote to close the Ashby Elementary School and the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainants argue the notice's '2025-2026 Proposed Budget' topic was too vague to cover the school-closure discussion and vote.
allegations.key_passage: we are satisfied that the “2025-2026 Proposed Budget” topic on the meeting notice was sufficiently specific.

allegations.summary: Complainants argue the notice had to specify that a vote would be taken on closing Ashby Elementary School.
allegations.key_passage: it is reasonably foreseeable that a public body may take action and hold a vote following discussion of a topic listed on a meeting notice
